comment.body: Thanks for noting that New key fails as well as pairing. This behavior is already being investigated in #51567; #51789 is the open candidate for the mixed-signer rejection demonstrated there. It is not merged or shipped, and this message alone does not establish the exact cause on your installation. Please keep follow-up evidence with that investigation rather than resetting or publishing security keys. Repeating remote firewall checks would not explain a local New key failure.

judgment.recommended_action: Group with51567 and the open51789 candidate, without claiming a proven identical local cause or shipped fix.
evidence: The reporter identifies Store installation and0.102.3001, and says both pairing and pressing New key fail with the same visible message.
Issue51567 covers the same local key-generation/pairing class. PR51789 explicitly targets the demonstrated mixed-Microsoft-signer rejection there and is currently open/unmerged.
This new report has no supplied diagnostics or discussion; its generic error does not prove a specific certificate, network or service failure.
judgment.rationale: Route the matching failure to existing owned work rather than creating a competing implementation or asking the reporter to reset keys. A local New key failure is not explained by remote firewall checks alone. Keep the candidate status and limits explicit.
